description:
Aggregate statistics on the reduced-hours job market: how many employers are tracked, how many run each schedule type, the distribution of weekly hours, and which day the non-working day falls on.

Use this for "how common is a 4-day week" questions. The response separates genuinely reduced-hours employers from compressed 4x10 employers, and reports the full-pay and pro-rata splits separately, so quote whichever the question actually asked for. Figures carry an as_of date; cite it.
name: get_market_stats
title: Market statistics
